title: FloodPay Flood Events, Trigger Bands and Payout Decisions
content:
## Claims desk guidance — FloodPay Parametric Flood Cover (Surplus Lines)

FloodPay pays a pre-agreed amount when the sensor's measured depth crosses a trigger band. This guidance sets out how readings form a flood event, which band an event pays, when a payout is made and when it is declined.

### The rule

**Flood events and bands.** All readings within the tier's flood event window, in elapsed hours, of the first reading above the band 1 depth belong to one flood event, which pays at most the tier's number of payouts per flood event on its peak verified depth: band 3 at or above the band 3 depth pays the band 3 percent of the payout limit, band 2 at or above the band 2 depth pays the band 2 percent, and band 1 at or above the band 1 depth pays the band 1 percent.

**Conditions of payment.** A payout is made only on a reading that passed the sensor health check when reading verification is required, only for an event that starts at least the standard waiting period in calendar days after the sensor activated, and only while the policy status is active; readings from a moved or tampered sensor are void when the tamper exclusion applies.

**Payment and confirmation.** The payout is issued by the tier's payout method to the tier's payee within the tier's payout period in business days of the verified trigger, and Tidemark confirms the trigger within the tier's confirmation period in hours.

**Declines.** An event that reaches no band, starts in the waiting period, falls in a sensor fault or rests on an unverified reading is declined in writing.

### Band 1 by tier

The band 1 figures differ between tiers:

| Tier | Band 1 depth (inches) | Band 1 pays (% of the payout limit) |
|---|---|---|
| FloodPay Home 5K | 2 | 25 |
| FloodPay Home 10K | 2 | 25 |
| FloodPay Home 25K | 2 | 25 |
| FloodPay Business 50K | 2 | 25 |
| FloodPay Business 100K | 2 | 25 |
| FloodPay Business 250K | 4 | 20 |

### Which band an event reaches

The band is read from the event's peak verified depth, the highest band reached governing:

| Peak verified depth | Band reached | Pays |
|---|---|---|
| At or above the band 3 depth | Band 3 | Band 3 percent of the payout limit |
| At or above the band 2 depth, below the band 3 depth | Band 2 | Band 2 percent of the payout limit |
| At or above the band 1 depth, below the band 2 depth | Band 1 | Band 1 percent of the payout limit |
| Below the band 1 depth | No band | Declined in writing |

### Conditions of payment, element by element

| Element | Record looked at | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Verified reading | The recorded result of the sensor health check for the event's reading | The reading passed the health check |
| Waiting period | The event's start against the sensor's activation date | The event starts at least the waiting period, in calendar days, after activation |
| Policy status | The policy's status | Active |
| Sensor integrity | Whether the sensor was moved or tampered with | The reading does not come from a moved or tampered sensor (such readings are void when the tamper exclusion applies) |

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

*Hypothetical schedule:* a payout limit of 7,000 US dollars, bands at 3, 10 and 20 inches paying 30, 50 and 100 percent, a flood event window of 72 hours, 1 payout per event.

- Readings rise above 3 inches and peak at 14 inches within the window, verified, on an active policy past its waiting period: band 2, paying 50 percent of 7,000, which is 3,500 US dollars — one payout for the whole event, on the peak.
- A peak of exactly 20 inches reaches band 3 ("at or above"), paying 7,000 US dollars.
- A peak of 2 inches reaches no band: the event is declined in writing.
- *Waiting period, on the boundary.* An event starting on the calendar day that falls exactly the waiting period after the activation date meets the condition ("at least"); an event starting the day before falls in the waiting period and is declined in writing.
- An event that starts while cover is suspended for a sensor fault is declined in writing.

### Basis Q&A

**If readings fall and rise again within the window, is there a second payout?**
All readings within the window of the first reading above the band 1 depth belong to one flood event, and that event pays at most the tier's number of payouts per flood event, on its peak verified depth.
